story: Polihale State Park is a remote wild beach on the western side of the Hawaiian island of Kauaʻi. It is the most western publicly accessible area in Hawaii. A sea lettuce called pahapaha grows in the waters near Polihale.
matters: A wreath made from pahapaha from Polihale can fade and dry out, but when soaked in water, it will revive to its original freshness.
name: Polihale State Park
